name: Film and Video Production
description: Shooting, cutting and finishing moving pictures — for film, television, streaming, advertising and everything else that now needs video. ⚠⚠ 19 Florida public institutions award 814 credentials, and Miami Dade College alone awards 367 of them — 45% of the state's output, mostly as short certificates. ⚠ A field where 35% of the people working in it are self-employed.
degreesNote: ⚠⚠ ONE INSTITUTION IS NEARLY HALF THE STATE. Cinematography and Film/Video Production (50.0602) produced 814 credentials at 19 Florida public institutions: 384 certificates of twelve weeks to a year, 266 bachelor's, 118 associate, 25 master's. ⚠ Miami Dade College awards 367 of those, UCF 189, Broward 84, Valencia 60, Florida State 49. ⚠⚠ The certificate tier is where the volume is, which suits a freelance field — but it is worth knowing that the bachelor's producers are a much shorter list. ⚠⚠⚠ TWO INSTITUTIONAL SIGNATURES IN THE COURSE DATA THAT AFFECT TRANSFER. Measured across the statewide file, FLORIDA ATLANTIC runs the FIL prefix at FOUR CREDITS — 11 of its 21 undergraduate film courses — while everyone else runs three: UCF 78 of 103 at 3, USF 25 of 25, UNF 24 of 25, Broward 18 of 19. ⚠ That is one institutional choice, not a divergence on individual courses, and it means an FAU film student accumulates credit faster per course than a course count suggests. ⚠⚠ FLORIDA STATE runs 45 of its 70 film courses at VARIABLE credit, with UCF carrying 22 variable rows — the shape of a production school rather than a studies department, where the credit depends on the scope of the project. ⚠ Ask what a registration is worth before you register. ⚠⚠ AND THE NUMBERING IS UNSETTLED: History of Motion Pictures exists as FIL2030 at 4 institutions and FIL1030 at 3 with NO overlap, and FIL1420 and FIL1420C carry DIFFERENT titles at different institutions. Send syllabi on transfer.

cips.note: Cinematography and Film/Video Production — 19 Florida public institutions and 814 credentials in 2023: 384 certificates of twelve weeks to a year, 266 bachelor's, 118 associate, 25 master's, 21 longer certificates. ⚠ Miami Dade College 367 — 45% of the state total — then UCF 189, Broward 84, Valencia 60, Florida State 49, Palm Beach State 19.

related.note: ⚠⚠ The nearest neighbour and a warning worth carrying across: BLS projects graphic design to DECLINE 2% with AI named as the reason, while film and video editing is projected to grow 3% with no AI claim made at all. ⚠ Both are portfolio fields with no licence; the projections differ.

⚠ Named because most video work now ships through a screen interface, and the production skills stack with interactive ones. ⚠⚠ Web and digital interface designers earn $104,000 against film editors' $75,420, which is worth knowing if you are choosing where to point the same visual training.

⚠⚠ A destination almost nobody in film considers, and it is a good one: EME6209 Digital Video is taught at five Florida universities, training and development specialists number 452,300 with 43,900 annual openings, and the work is salaried rather than freelance. ⚠ For an editor tired of project work, this is the obvious move.

⚠⚠ 35% of film and video editors and camera operators are SELF-EMPLOYED. This is a freelance industry for more than a third of the people in it, and nothing in a film programme covers rates, contracts, insurance or quarterly estimated tax. ⚠ Florida teaches short business certificates at 30 institutions.

⚠ Named for a Florida-specific reason: theme parks, cruise lines and the Orlando attractions industry are substantial employers of in-house video production, and they hire differently from the film industry proper — salaried, year-round and local.
